## History

Carrie Sloane was present at Diana's party when [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dared [Anne](../character/anne.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, which resulted in [Anne](../character/anne.md) falling and breaking her ankle.
